items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I was with Buddy Rich’s band and it was a very exciting band he had

ctx.x: I want to ask you about being the accompanist and the music director for one of the greatest and most recognizable jazz voices there’s ever been, Tony Bennett.

Yeah. Well he was, you know I had a, I didn’t have that kind of background at all. He, I guess he heard me play a solo when I used to be the relief piano player at the Hickory House in New York, and I had very little experience playing with singers and none as a conductor. And anyhow then later years passed and I was with Buddy Rich’s band and it was a very exciting band he had, and Tony came, it happened right here in L.A. There was a club here that didn’t last very long and we were playing and Tony Bennett was…
What’s your favorite setting? Your overall favorite setting as a keyboard artist?
